notes: ACCESS: robots.txt at anthropologie.com/robots.txt has generic 'User-agent: *  Allow: /' with a Crawl-delay:10 and no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow -> proceeded via Chrome tab. TREE METHOD: union of mega-menu 'Home & Furniture' tab (/house-home) top-level sidebar (Art & Mirrors, Bath, Bedding, Candles & Home Fragrance, Decor & Pillows, Furniture, Kitchen & Dining, Lighting, Outdoor, Rugs) plus each category's own left-nav sub-list, visited directly (mega-menu hover did not expand a flyout in this session so the left-rail sidebar on each landing page was used as the sub-nav source, which is the site's standard pattern here). QTY METHOD: rendered 'N products' header text on each category listing page (confirmed via find tool + get_page_text), taken verbatim, no pagination math. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): Art & Mirrors, Candles & Home Fragrance, Lighting (own categories); Bath Hardware, Bath Vanities, Bath Mirrors, Cleaning Products (fixtures/hardware/non-storage); Bath Accessories/'Bath Decor' (272 products, overwhelmingly decorative soap dishes/canisters/tissue-box-covers/trays with only 2 incidental hamper SKUs -> not forced into Storage per storage.md 24; belongs to Decorative Home Accessories, already validated); Kitchen Tools & Accessories (cookware/gadgets, no storage-purpose items found); Garden & Utility (garden tools, not storage); Outdoor Furniture, Outdoor Entertaining, Planters, Beach & Pool Gear, Fire Pits & Accessories (non-textile/non-storage); Furniture top-level and its explicit 'Storage Furniture, Cabinets & Consoles' subcategory (site places this under Furniture nav explicitly -> Furniture.xlsx territory per storage.md 21/27, not re-classified here); Drinkware/Mugs/Dinnerware/Serveware/Bar Tools/Cookware & Bakeware/Flatware/Kitchen Appliances/Gourmet Food & Drink (Kitchen & Dining, not textile/storage). DUPLICATE HANDLING: /bedding-pillows ('Boho Throw Pillows & Accent Pillows', 260 products) and /decorative-pillows ('Pillows & Throw Pillows', 260 products) are the identical product listing reached via two nav paths (Bedding>Pillows and Decor&Pillows>Pillows) -> recorded once under Decor & Pillows per duplicate rule. /bedding-throws redirects (server-side) to /blankets-throws -> recorded once under Decor & Pillows. Rugs top page (/rugs, 360 products) has valid subcategories so the parent URL was not recorded; its Area Rugs/Runners/Doormats/Persian Rugs subcategory pages were recorded individually per the parent-category-URL rule even though their counts overlap (site-provided filtered nav links, consistent with prior project convention of not deduplicating overlapping subset counts). Bed Skirts is a sidebar-provided itemType-filtered link (/bedding-sheets?itemType=Bedskirt) confirmed via h1/breadcrumb to render a distinct 14-product Bed Skirt listing -> kept, MEDIUM confidence for the query-param URL form. STORAGE: 'Storage & Organization' (/organization-storage, 285 products) is the site's own explicit top-level Decor & Pillows subcategory name -> HIGH confidence despite some incidental decorative trinket-dish SKUs mixed in (site hierarchy trusted per storage.md core principle). 'Wall Storage & Hooks' (/bathroom-hooks, 30 products) mixes genuine storage (wall cabinets, medicine cabinet) with hooks/shelves that lean decorative -> MEDIUM confidence, kept because the site's own category name is explicitly 'Storage'. No dedicated Laundry/Hamper/Pantry/Office/Closet storage category exists anywhere in the nav (only a handful of hamper/trunk SKUs embedded inside Storage & Organization, already covered by that row).
